evals.name: inspect_build_env
evals.prompt: Inspect the camera-kit build environment for project AX615_dashcam_nor
evals.expected_output: Inspection output showing project name, architecture, available modules (3rd, com, service, client, apps), and compiler toolchain information.
expectations: Lists core submodules: 3rd, com, service, client, apps

evals.name: dry_run_service_build
evals.prompt: Dry-run building the service submodule for project AX615_dashcam_nor
evals.expected_output: A dry-run command showing the exact make invocation for service module without altering files.
expectations: Verifies no compilation errors in command formulation

evals.name: verify_opt_filelist
evals.prompt: Validate that opt.filelist includes required AXCK runtime binaries and libraries
evals.expected_output: Verification results ensuring axck_service, libaxck_client.so, and config files are properly declared in opt.filelist.
expectations: Ensures config files are packaged to /opt/bin and /opt/etc
